propositions: Ticking an AC checkbox does not invalidate a plan-review attestation because checkbox state is normalized out of the material basis before hashing.
The current attestation staleness message names a fixed list (description/AC/file_impact/children) that does not match the actual hashing basis and omits which input actually changed.

Pre-330c attestations hashed raw description and cannot match either the normalized recompute or the legacy grandfather when the ticket is unchanged, producing false stale-material verdicts with hidden causes.
The material fingerprint basis comprises exactly four keys (ticket_id, description, file_impact, children) plus file_impact_scope when scope is none; AC is not a separate component.

Per-component fingerprints must be stored in the signed manifest as additive material-part: lines and recovered from that record at read time, not reconstructed, because children derives from other tickets at read time.
All attestation refusal surfaces must be swept to name changed components in their reason strings and advise correct remedies, not generic fixed lists or stale advice.
